name: Rágol (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, green and white with a green middle stripe of double width, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Rágol (a vine on white above waves).
history: Rágol adopted its arms and flag officially on 29 July 2000; the flag is one and a half times longer than wide, formed of three horizontal stripes, white, green and white, the green twice the width of the white ones.
